info.name: Security Gate Vehicle Entry API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the Security Gate Vehicle Entry System.
Fastify + TypeScript + Drizzle ORM + PostgreSQL.
All IDs are UUIDs.

Standard error response format:
{
  "status": false,
  "statusCode": 400,
  "error": "Validation Error",
  "message": "field: error details"
}
